expected_physical_sequence: One packet enters at every tick from 0 through 4.

One packet exits at every tick from 2 through 6 and no queue forms.
expected_result_summary: Entries rise 1,2,3,4,5 and exits reproduce that cadence after two ticks; point queue is always zero.
limits_on_interpretation: Unit-packet discrete-time case; no empirical claim.
